top_signals.title: Treasuries Stabilize After Selloff, Stocks Slip: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A Treasury selloff stabilized in early Asian trading after elevated oil prices stemming from the US-Iran standoff and bets on further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes pushed yields to multi-year highs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
